name: hackriff-ui
description: hackriff web UI (T-022a, T-044, T-051): WebGL2 waterfall over the stream bridge, SDR control panel, region-over-time history; MUI one-screen app at /app.html (T-149, ADR-0013)

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --minify --sourcemap --target=es2020 --outfile=dist/main.js && esbuild src/audio-worklet.ts --bundle --minify --target=es2020 --outfile=dist/audio-worklet.js && cp src/index.html src/style.css dist/ && esbuild src/app/main.ts --bundle --minify --sourcemap --target=es2020 --outfile=dist/app.js && esbuild src/app/app.css --bundle --minify --outfile=dist/app.css && cp src/app/index.html dist/app.html
